legal.quienesSomosDesc: Neuropsychology and Therapies SANTI is a therapy center specialized in child ABA, ASD and ADHD intervention located in Pueblo Libre, Lima, Peru. We operate the SANTI digital platform for clinical management and communication with families.
legal.queInfoDesc: We only collect the information necessary to provide our services:
legal.datosValorCuenta: full name, email address, phone number.
legal.datosValorPac: name, date of birth, clinical diagnosis, session history and therapeutic progress.
legal.datosValorUso: ABA session records, clinical forms, evaluations and generated reports.
legal.datosLabelGoogle: Google data (if you use Google sign-in):
legal.datosValorGoogle: name, email address and profile photo provided by Google.
legal.usoGestionar: Manage the patient's clinical history and therapeutic follow-up.
legal.usoGenerar: Generate progress reports for families and professionals.
legal.usoMejorar: Improve our clinical services and the SANTI platform.
legal.conQuienTitulo: 4. Who we share the information with
legal.conQuienDesc: We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. We only share information with:

legal.derechoElim: Deletion of your account and associated data.
legal.contactoDesc: For any questions about this policy:
